lee-mao.text: "My top priority is keeping Diamond bar safe": consider more sheriff patrols, expanded neighborhood watch, license plate readers "and quickly moving our homeless into appropriate shelter."

source.title: Lee Mao for Diamond Bar City Council 2026 (campaign site)

lee-mao.text: Wants to grow businesses and implement the Downtown Diamond Bar expansion "to increase our dining, retail and entertainment revenue without tax increases"; "Fiscal responsibility is not optional, it is essential."

source.title: Lee Mao for Diamond Bar City Council 2026 (campaign site)

lee-mao.text: On traffic: push Caltrans and USDOT to finish freeway improvements, synchronize lights, "fund more traffic officers, and add traffic calming measures to discourage non-local drivers."

source.title: Lee Mao for Diamond Bar City Council 2026 (campaign site)

lee-mao.text: Says Edison's intentional high-fire-period power shutoffs need alternatives: "Our residents should not have to endure days without power."

source.title: Lee Mao for Diamond Bar City Council 2026 (campaign site)
